title: Driver Salary Receipt Generator
name: Driver Salary Receipt
summary: Monthly pay receipt for a driver.
description: Create a salary receipt for a driver with monthly pay, overtime, allowances and deductions. Preview instantly and download as PDF.
intro: A driver salary receipt records the pay of a driver for a period. It shows the monthly pay, overtime, allowances and deductions.

print.title: Driver Salary Receipt
print.certify_plain: This is to certify that I have paid {amount} to the driver, {driver}, for the month of {month}.
print.certify_plain_period: This is to certify that I have paid {amount} to the driver, {driver}, for the period {month}.
print.certify_self: This is to certify that I have paid {amount} to driver {driver} for the month of {month} (acknowledged receipt enclosed).
print.reimburse: Please reimburse the above amount. I further declare that what is stated above is correct and true.
print.received_sum: I have received a sum of {amount} only for the month of {month} from {employer}.
print.ack_certify: This is to certify that I have paid {amount} to the driver, {driver}, for the month of {month} (Acknowledged receipt enclosed below).
print.ack_certify_period: This is to certify that I have paid {amount} to the driver, {driver}, for the period {month} (Acknowledged receipt enclosed below).
print.ack_reimburse: Please reimburse the above amount to my account.
print.ack_further: I further declare that what is stated above is correct and true to the best of my knowledge and belief.
print.ack_heading: Payment Receipt & Acknowledgement (to be signed by the driver)
print.ack_received: Received a sum of {amount} ({words}) for the month of {month} from {employer}.
print.ack_received_period: Received a sum of {amount} ({words}) for the period {month} from {employer}.
print.ack_voucher: Received by {driver} from {employer} towards salary for {month}.
print.name: Name
print.confirm: I confirm receipt of the salary amount stated above from the payer for the month mentioned in this record.
print.note_1: Salary covers the stated month only.
print.note_2: Overtime and allowances are included only where listed.

sample.declaration: I also declare that the driver is exclusively utilized for official purpose only.
